label: plant translocation
definition: Deliberate human movement of living plants, or whole rooted plant material, from one site to another, as when a species is transplanted into a restoration site.
source: docs/camo_annotation_guide.html (Murphy 2005 walkthrough, node 1; also 'plant translocation process' in the free-text callout)
example_usage: Murphy 2005 walkthrough (docs/camo_annotation_guide.html), node 1 "Introduction of transplanted S. canadensis": entity_type management_intervention, entity_term "plant translocation" as free text, state_or_change_qualifier introduced.

label: resource availability
definition: The amount of a resource, such as light, water, nutrients or space, that is accessible to organisms in a given place and time, treated as a limiting-factor variable.
example_usage: Murphy 2005 walkthrough, node 4 "Decreased resource availability to A. petiolata": entity_type environmental_variable, entity_term "resource availability" as free text, state_or_change_qualifier decreased.

label: re-establishment
definition: The return of a species or group of species to a site from which they had been lost or reduced, whether by natural recolonization or by planting or seeding.
example_usage: Murphy 2005 walkthrough, node 7 "Reestablishment of native understory species": entity_type environmental_variable, entity_term "re-establishment" as free text, state_or_change_qualifier increased, negated at the edge.

label: native species
definition: Species occurring within their natural range at a site, not introduced by people. Relational: nativeness depends on the geographic or jurisdictional context the source states.
source: causalmosaic.yaml (CausalNode.applied_to description, free-text guild example); CHANGELOG.md 0.7.x 'tracked in the project NAO list'
example_usage: causalmosaic.yaml, CausalNode.applied_to description: "abundance of native species", with the free-text guild "native species" in applied_to.entity_term.

label: shade-tolerant species
definition: Plant species able to survive and grow under low light, such as beneath a closed canopy, used as a functional group. Membership is taken from the source's own classification.
source: causalmosaic.yaml (CausalNode.applied_to description, free-text guild example); CHANGELOG.md 0.7.x
example_usage: causalmosaic.yaml, CausalNode.applied_to description: listed as a free-text guild value for applied_to.entity_term. No worked example node.

label: invasive plants
definition: Plant species that are non-native to a site and spread there in ways that harm native biota or ecosystem function. Relational: depends on the site and on the source's judgement of harm.
example_usage: causalmosaic.yaml, CausalNode.applied_to description: listed as a free-text guild value for applied_to.entity_term. No worked example node.
